title: Sodium Oxalate Filter
model_title: Horizontal Pressure-Leaf Filter for Sodium Oxalate

introduction.definition: A horizontal pressure-leaf filter separates sodium oxalate crystals from liquor. Slurry is pumped into the closed shell; cake forms on vertical mesh leaves while filtrate leaves through the manifold. The shell then rolls back and the cake is sluiced off.

pressure.title: Pressure filtration, then cake discharge
pressure.description: Slurry is pumped into the closed shell under pressure (typically a few bar); liquid passes through the leaf screens into the manifold while oxalate builds up as cake on both faces of each leaf. At the end of the cycle the shell is drained, opened (rolled back) and the cake is sluiced or vibrated off into the hopper.

script.narration: This module introduces the Sodium Oxalate Filter.
A horizontal pressure-leaf filter separates sodium oxalate crystals from liquor.
Slurry is pumped into the closed shell; cake forms on vertical mesh leaves while filtrate leaves through the manifold.
The shell then rolls back and the cake is sluiced off.
Typical applications include oxalate removal; polishing filtration.

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Sodium Oxalate Filter.
Check cycle and filtrate clarity.
Inspect leaf screens.
Replace leaves; shell seal.
Watch for torn leaf: cloudy filtrate. Common cause: damage, wear.
Watch for seal leak: leakage. Common cause: worn seal.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
